title: contract.md frontmatter: the unit of work
description: The fields of a ticket's contract (E-22, A5, A7). check-specs validates every contract's frontmatter against this file; the rules no schema can carry (one surface, reviewers by path, the 2,500-token cap, yarn scripts) are in tooling/lib/specs.ts.

size.description: small: under half a day, the default. medium: half a day to two days. large: over two days; split it.

cites.description: Surface files (paths), decision IDs and criterion IDs from those files.

waiver.description: Why this ticket cites more than one surface file.

reviewers.description: Computed by contract:init from planned_paths and toolkit.json; each has a review:<role> criterion.

tier.description: QA tier (PR-15). 0: docs and data, checks only. 1: code, reviewed with its batch. 2: a one-way door, pre-flighted and reviewed on the ticket. Written by contract:init from planned_paths; changed with contract:tier.

operator_review.description: true when Taylor wants to look the ticket over himself, as for a new surface in the browser (PR-16). contract:init adds a manual criterion for it; the builder hands it over as an operator check, and the ticket still closes.

command.description: test and check: a package.json script run through yarn, as in `yarn test:tooling`.

path.description: capture: where the evidence file will be.

reason.description: manual: why no script can prove it.
